description: Threads (Meta) profile: name, verified flag, bio, follower count and bio links, plus the latest posts the public profile page shows (about 10, including the author's own thread continuations) with text, time, likes, replies, reposts, quotes, media URLs and link. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
